scripts.build: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-sdk build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-assistant-ui-runtime build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-ui build && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge build
scripts.dev:no-watch: cross-env STANDALONE=false NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge --filter frontend dev:no-watch
scripts.dev:server:ui: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge build:frontend-assets && cross-env STANDALONE=false NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core --filter @truefoundry/trueforge dev
scripts.dev: cross-env STANDALONE=false NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core --filter @truefoundry/trueforge --filter frontend dev
scripts.smoke: docker compose up --build --wait && node -e "Promise.all([fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8791/healthz'), fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8791/')]).then(async ([health, ui]) => { if (!health.ok) throw new Error('healthz returned ' + health.status); const html = await ui.text(); if (!ui.ok || !html.includes('id=\"root\"')) throw new Error('UI did not return its app shell'); console.log('healthz and UI OK'); })"
scripts.standalone:dev:no-watch: cross-env STANDALONE=true NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge --filter frontend dev:no-watch
scripts.standalone:dev: cross-env STANDALONE=true NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core --filter @truefoundry/trueforge --filter frontend dev
scripts.test: pnpm test:trueforge-core && pnpm test:assistant-ui-runtime && pnpm test:trueforge-ui && pnpm test:trueforge && pnpm test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-assistant-ui-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
scripts.inflex:test: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core test --runInBand && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge test --runInBand tests/unit/inflex tests/unit/runtime/sessionResources.test.ts && pnpm inflex:media:test
scripts.inflex:desktop:prepare: pnpm build && pnpm inflex:native:build && node scripts/inflex-desktop-resources.mjs
scripts.inflex:browser:test: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge exec cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=trueforge-dev tsx scripts/probe-inflex-browser.ts
scripts.inflex:documents:test: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge exec cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=trueforge-dev tsx scripts/probe-inflex-documents.ts
scripts.inflex:benchmark: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge exec cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=trueforge-dev tsx scripts/benchmark-inflex.ts
scripts.inflex:desktop:format: swift format format --in-place --recursive desktop/Sources desktop/Tests/InflexClientTests desktop/Tests/InflexUITests desktop/Package.swift desktop/Resources/make-icon.swift
